console.uploadKeepTabOpen: Keep this tab open until the file finishes sending.
console.autoStartSillyTavernHint: Off if you would rather start it yourself.

console.storageTemporaryTitle: This machine does not keep your data
console.storageTemporaryBody: The storage this manager is running on is temporary. It can be emptied when the machine restarts, and some hosts stop a machine that has been idle for a while - chats, characters and settings would go with it. Connect Cloudflare R2 below and backups are sent somewhere that is not this machine, so they can be restored after a reset.
console.r2Pitch: Your data stays safe in the cloud. If this machine breaks, is lost, or you move to a new one, connect to the cloud again and everything comes back.
console.r2ColdEvery: Send images and the rest every (hours)
console.r2KeepDaily: Days that keep one point each
console.r2KeepWeekly: Weeks that keep one point each
console.r2Fetched: Brought back into the backup library. Restore it from there.
console.r2FetchFailed: The recovery point could not be fetched
console.r2FetchNote: A recovery point brought back lands in your backups. Nothing changes until you restore it.
console.r2LegacyRemoveFailed: The older backups could not be removed
console.r2UsageNote: Counted by the manager as it works, not read back from Cloudflare. The R2 page of your Cloudflare dashboard is the final word.

console.r2FromEnv: Fields set in .env are shown here and can only be changed in .env.

console.r2History: How far back you can restore

console.r2CustomHint: This doesn't match a ready-made option. Adjust the exact numbers below to change it.

console.restoreStopped: Restore stopped. Your data is as it was before.

settings.lazyLoadCharactersHint: Faster with a large library. A few extensions do not expect it.

settings.requestCompressionHint: Worth having over a remote link or a slow network.
settings.extensionsHint: Turn off to find out whether an extension is what broke.

console.cfChooseAccount: Choose which Cloudflare account to back up to.
console.cfReconnectHint: Cloudflare no longer accepts this sign-in. Reconnect to keep backing up.

console.cfErrorLoginRequired: Sign in to the manager first, then connect Cloudflare again.
console.cfErrorStateMismatch: That sign-in expired or was started somewhere else. Connect again.
console.cfErrorDenied: Access was not granted on Cloudflare.
console.cfErrorUnavailable: This manager has no Cloudflare sign-in configured.
console.cfErrorGeneric: Connecting to Cloudflare failed ({code}). Try again.

console.cfUsageNotGranted: Analytics permission was not granted, so only the manager's own counts are shown.

console.r2ScheduleBody: How often changes are sent, and how far back you can restore.
console.cfBucketBody: Every R2 bucket in this Cloudflare account. Backups sent to another bucket start from what that bucket already holds; nothing is deleted from this one.

console.r2RecoveredBodyNoSize: This machine started with an empty data profile, so the recovery point in the cloud taken {when} was restored before SillyTavern was started.

console.managerTunnelOffConfirmBodyHere: You are reading this page through that link, so it will go blank. Reach the console at its own address to turn the link back on.

errors.cloudflare_authorization_denied: Access was not granted on Cloudflare.
errors.cloudflare_conflict: Cloudflare refused that because something with the same name is already there.

errors.cloudflare_state_mismatch: That sign-in expired or was started somewhere else. Connect again.

errors.cloudflare_unknown_bucket: This Cloudflare account has no bucket by that name.
errors.invalid_object_key: That object name is not one this manager wrote.

errors.r2_check_failed: The bucket could not be read.
errors.r2_rate_limited: Cloudflare's API limit was reached. Backups carry on shortly.

errors.csrf_failed: This page has been open a while and the request was refused. Reload and try again.
errors.git_failed: Git could not fetch this version.
errors.github_invalid_response: GitHub answered with something the manager could not read.

errors.installation_busy: Another installation is already running. Wait for it to finish.
errors.installation_marker_mismatch: This copy of SillyTavern does not match its record. Install it again.
errors.installation_marker_missing: This copy of SillyTavern is incomplete. Install it again.
errors.installation_not_found: That installation is not there any more.
errors.installation_not_ready: That installation did not finish. Install it again.
errors.internal_error: Something went wrong in the manager. The log says what.

errors.invalid_backup_name: That name cannot be used for a backup.

errors.invalid_passcode: The passcode must be six digits.

errors.invalid_revision: That version could not be read from GitHub.
errors.invalid_upload: The upload could not be read.
errors.invalid_upload_chunk: A piece of the upload was rejected.
errors.invalid_upload_id: The upload could not be read.
errors.invalid_upload_state: The upload is no longer in a state it can be finished from.
errors.invalid_yaml: That is not valid YAML, so nothing was saved.
errors.job_not_running: That job is no longer running.
errors.linked_path: The profile contains a linked path, which a backup cannot follow safely.
errors.origin_rejected: That request did not come from this manager, so it was refused.
errors.panel_unavailable: The manager panel has not been built yet.
errors.password_confirmation_mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
errors.profile_name_taken: A profile already has that name.
errors.profile_not_found: That profile is not there any more.
errors.public_access_password_required: Set a SillyTavern password before letting other devices in.
errors.r2_disabled: Backing up to Cloudflare R2 is switched off.
errors.r2_not_configured: Set up the R2 connection first.
errors.r2_operation_ceiling: This month has reached the write-operation limit set here, so nothing was sent.

errors.r2_unreadable_snapshot: That recovery point could not be read back.

errors.unauthorized: You are signed out. Sign in again.

errors.upload_chunk_too_large: That upload sent too much at once.
errors.upload_incomplete: The upload did not arrive in full. Send it again.
